# The Style Room — Haute Atelier & Luxury Fashion Boutique

> Curated contemporary luxury women's fashion handcrafted in Indore, India. Pure 22-momme mulberry silks, fluid tailored silhouettes, organic cotton poplin blouses, and capsule wardrobes with complimentary express delivery across India.

## Core Navigation & Catalogs
- [/](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/): Haute Atelier Homepage showcasing seasonal couture edits, benefits, and stories.
- [/shop](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/shop): Complete catalog of women's dresses, tops, and capsules with search and fabric filters.
- [/category/dresses](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/category/dresses): Women's Couture & Dresses — Silk slips, tiered maxi dresses, ribbed knit midi dresses, pleated cocktail gowns.
- [/category/tops](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/category/tops): Curated Tops & Capsules — Linen resort shirts, satin blouses, poplin cropped tops, tailored jackets.
- [/category/new](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/category/new): Fresh runway-inspired 2026 couture drops just unveiled in our atelier.

## Brand & Client Care
- [/about](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/about): Our Story & Heritage — 15+ years of master tailoring in Indore, fair artisan wages, and 22-momme mulberry silk standard.
- [/journal](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/journal): The Style Journal — Editorial trend forecasts, capsule wardrobe guides, and mulberry silk garment care masterclasses.
- [/contact](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/contact): Client Concierge — WhatsApp booking, Indore atelier showroom visits, custom alteration requests, and comprehensive FAQs.
- [/cart](https://the-style-room.vercel.app/cart): Shopping Bag & Checkout with promo code support, express courier options, and direct WhatsApp order confirmation.
